title: Who killed Tupac? What to know about the trial of Duane ‘Keffe D’ Davis
facts: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis went on trial in Las Vegas for allegedly orchestrating the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur.
Duane Davis is charged with one count of murder with a deadly weapon with the intent to promote, further or assist a criminal gang.
Duane Davis was 63 years old at the start of his murder trial.
Tupac Shakur was fatally wounded in a drive-by shooting in Nevada on September 7, 1996.
Tupac Shakur died six days after the shooting at the age of 25.
Marion 'Suge' Knight founded Death Row Records.
Tupac Shakur and Suge Knight were involved in a physical fight at the MGM Grand hours before the shooting.
Orlando 'Baby Lane' Anderson was the nephew of Duane Davis and was involved in the fight at the MGM Grand.
Tupac Shakur was shot six times from a white Cadillac in Las Vegas.
Authorities stated that Duane Davis was one of four men inside the white Cadillac during the shooting.
Duane Davis entered a not guilty plea in November 2023.
Duane Davis is the former leader of the South Side Compton Crips gang.
Duane Davis authored a 2019 memoir titled 'Compton Street Legend'.
Suge Knight is currently serving a 28-year prison sentence for running over and killing a Compton businessman in 2015.
Prosecutors expect to call between 35 and 45 witnesses during the trial of Duane Davis.
